messages:
Noah (CS): Heads up — Aurora hit our spend alert for embeddings at 88%. QBR in 9 days. Can we assemble a quick mitigation and an ask for the deck?

Elena (FinOps): Pulling numbers. Early: embeddings up ~180% last 48h due to daily recompute job. Generation usage flat.

Sam (AE): Customer did a nightly full-index rebuild yesterday. They said it was scheduled. Renewal in ~40 days, they're sensitive to surprises.

Jin (SRE): Found the rebuild job used batch_size=1 and retried aggressively on 502s. I've applied retry-backoff and increased batch_size to 6. Rolling now.

Noah (CS): Proposed short fixes: 1) temporary soft rate limit at 80% of baseline for embed endpoint, 2) one-time $7k credit offer pending finance, 3) enable KV caching for repeated vectors, 4) run a 30-min enablement on batching.

Elena (FinOps): Approve provisional $3k credit; finance to confirm. I'll produce a 2-slide incident summary + 4-week forecast for QBR. Include an option: migrate to Dedicated (estimated 20% unit cost savings).

Ops Bot: Budget alert: account=aurora level=88% action=notify channel=#customer-success ts=2142223400

Sam (AE): I'll notify the CTO about temporary rate limit and propose enablement session Tue 9am PT. Also mention Dedicated as cost option in QBR.

Jin (SRE): Canary complete — error rate dropped from 6% -> 1.5%. Monitoring linked: https://internal/dash/aurora.

Noah (CS): Action items: Elena - slides & forecast; Jin - confirm cache behavior; Sam - schedule enablement and confirm renewal; CS - craft QBR bullet on risk+recommendation. Due EOD tomorrow.

Elena (FinOps): Slide draft uploaded to QBR deck. Forecast shows if rebuild continues, >$12k overage next month. Scenarios added (no change, hard throttle, Dedicated).

Sam (AE): Invite sent, CTO accepted. Finance approved $3k credit.

Noah (CS): Great. For the QBR emphasize cause (recompute), short-term controls, and migration path with estimated savings. We'll rehearse in prep sync. :white_check_mark:
